name: charm-claude-harness
description: Terminal-based orchestration charm for multi-agent Claude Code workflows

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:mcp && bun run build:console && bun run build:graph
scripts.build:cli: mkdir -p dist && cd dist && bun build ../src/cli.ts --compile --outfile charm-claude
scripts.build:daemon: mkdir -p dist && cd dist && bun build ../src/daemon/index.ts --compile --outfile charmd
scripts.build:mcp: mkdir -p dist && cd dist && bun build ../src/mcp/server.ts --compile --outfile charm-mcp
scripts.build:console: mkdir -p dist && cd dist && bun build ../src/console/app.tsx --compile --outfile charm-console
scripts.build:graph: mkdir -p dist && cd dist && bun build ../src/console/graph.ts --compile --outfile charm-graph
